artStyle: Cutout/puppet paper-collage animation, bouncy shapes, bold flat colors, playful jointed characters.
lighting: Flat bright lighting, no realistic shadow, high contrast and cheerful.
compositionRules: Bouncy centered characters synced to a musical beat, upper third kept clear for captions.
culturalMarkers: Universal sing-along settings — stages, backyards, playrooms — bright and inclusive.
antiArtifactGuidance: Consistent cutout-paper texture, clean joint/hinge points on characters, no melted shapes.
